heroHeadline: Swiss FA Withdraws Support for Infantino as FIFA Governance Row Deepens
heroSubtitle: The Swiss Football Association rescinded its endorsement of Gianni Infantino's re-election bid, citing transparency and accountability concerns, after England, Wales, France and Serbia did the same. The FIFA Council meets Oct 15 to consider Infantino's proposed governance review, ahead of the March 2027 election in Morocco.
